attempt_and_failure_policy.infrastructure_failures: exceptions (CUDA/OOM/process kill/disk) are logged in INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURES.jsonl, never recorded as model outputs; the run stops and the identical command resumes with unchanged seeds; completed pairs are skipped only when their fingerprint matches
attempt_and_failure_policy.invalid_generation: parse/schema/semantic failures are retained in the denominator and scored with the frozen persistent-failure rule: answer F1 = EM = 0, answerability = GENERATION_FAILURE (incorrect, never abstention); retrieval metrics scored from the sealed logs
attempt_and_failure_policy.repair: prohibited: no field insertion, type coercion, enum rewriting, evidence-ID insertion or JSON correction
attempt_and_failure_policy.time_expiry: the runner stops before starting a dependency-group unit that cannot finish before the hard deadline; the planned manifest is not redefined; missing pairs are reported as missing

context_policy.capacity_check: rendered prompt tokens + 1,600 output allowance must be <= model max_position_embeddings (40,960); otherwise hard stop, never truncate
context_policy.qwen_token_logging: Qwen-token counts of supplied evidence and of the full rendered prompt are logged per pair
context_policy.repacking_rationale: the frozen cap is defined in retrieval-tokenizer units, independent of the answer model; supplied evidence is therefore byte-identical to the sealed v1.1 requests for all three systems
context_policy.supplied_evidence_cap: 1,600 tokens counted with the frozen MiniLM retrieval tokenizer by the frozen v1.1 post-retrieval packer (complete chunks only, native order, never truncated)

observations: invalid smoke outputs were uncited 'missing information' claims rejected by the frozen validator (model behavior, not transport)
Qwen labelled no valid smoke output ANSWERABLE (mostly PARTIALLY_ANSWERABLE); scientific instructions deliberately NOT changed
no parse, schema-type, thinking-marker, truncation, offload or infrastructure problems

interpretation_limits: reduced sample under a five-hour budget; not the full held-out evaluation
single generator family (Qwen3-8B), 8B capacity, 4-bit NF4 quantization
stochastic decoding; one sample per pair
hardware/software specific; fixed seeds do not guarantee cross-platform identity
invalid generations counted as failures in the denominator
valid evidence IDs do not establish claim faithfulness
MuSiQue is development-split evidence; QASPER test supports dataset-specific test claims only
public-benchmark pretraining exposure of Qwen3 is unknown

prompt.schema_transport: system message = v1.1 system prompt + blank line + fixed instruction + compact schema JSON; user message byte-identical to v1.1

changed_relative_to_heldout_v1_1: answer generator: local Qwen/Qwen3-8B 4-bit NF4 instead of Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b
decoding: Qwen non-thinking sampling (T=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, min_p=0) with per-question seeds instead of T=0
transport: frozen schema rendered as text in the system message (no provider strict-JSON enforcement)
attempts: one attempt per pair; no content-based retries (held-out v1.1 allowed up to three)
sample: reduced label-blind random sample of the same eligible pool
no monetary cost; efficiency reported as local tokens/latency/VRAM
unchanged: v1.1 user prompt text and system prompt

inputs_provenance.source: Git LFS objects referenced by committed pointer files

retrieval.per_request_integrity: every sampled request must reproduce its sealed heldout_request_fingerprint_v1_1
retrieval.source: sealed held-out v1.1 REQUESTS.jsonl + RETRIEVAL_AND_PACKING_AUDIT.jsonl produced by the frozen retrieval code; recovered from Git LFS and SHA-256 verified

systems.traditional_k10: sentence_window exact dense index, static top-k=10 (FINAL_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.json)

runtime_estimate.rule: N = min(150, floor(0.8 * 0.95 * (budget_end - now - 1800s - load/warmup) / (3 * smoke mean e2e seconds per pair))), rounded down to a multiple of 4

sampling.execution_order: dependency-group units ordered by SHA-256('20260930|group-order|dependency_group'); questions by question_id within a unit; system order per question by SHA-256('20260930|system-order|dataset|question_id|system')
sampling.musique_full: equal-probability sample of dependency groups (both answerable and insufficient variants kept together): lowest SHA-256('20260930|sample|musique_full|dependency_group')
sampling.qasper: equal-probability sample of questions without replacement: lowest SHA-256('20260930|sample|qasper|question_id')
sampling.stratification: by dataset only (fixed 50/50); no stratification on answerability, evidence or outcomes

scope_statement: A REDUCED LOCAL STUDY under a five-hour execution-budget design. It is NOT the original full held-out evaluation (6,240 questions / 18,720 pairs), which remains preserved and unexecuted.

evidence: native retrieved-evidence recall (secondary, labeled as retrieved)
scoring.gold_access: only after PREDICTION_SEAL.json exists and verifies; gold normalized files must reproduce the SHA-256 recorded in the eligible pool
scoring.gold_file_identity: regenerated normalized gold files must match eligible-pool source_file_sha256 exactly or as CRLF-equivalent bytes
scoring.missing_pairs: pairs never attempted (time expiry or unresolved infrastructure stop) are reported as missing, not scored as model failures; paired comparisons use questions with all three systems attempted; attempted-but-invalid generations stay in the denominator as failures
scoring.prediction_text: space-joined claim texts (heldout v1.1 scorer rule); INSUFFICIENT gold scores F1 = EM = 1 only for a valid INSUFFICIENT prediction
scoring.undefined_gold_answerability: normalized QASPER records without gold_answerability (no usable reference answer and not unanimously unanswerable) get NaN answer/answerability/abstention metrics and are counted; evidence metrics still apply when gold spans exist (the unexecuted heldout v1.1 scorer would raise KeyError on such rows; no other scorer rule changes)

seeds.note: Fixed seeds improve repeatability but do not guarantee identical outputs across hardware or library versions.
seeds.rule: question_seed = int.from_bytes(SHA-256(UTF-8('{master_seed}|{dataset}|{question_id}'))[:4], 'big'); random.seed(question_seed) and torch.manual_seed(question_seed) immediately before every system's generate() call for that question

statistics.confidence_intervals: 10,000-replicate paired cluster bootstrap, 95% percentile, seed 20260926 (heldout v1.1 implementation)
statistics.interpretation: p > 0.05 or a CI crossing zero is reported as 'not statistically distinguishable in this study', never as equivalence; no equivalence test is declared
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across the three comparisons within each dataset x primary-metric family
statistics.secondary_metrics: Exact Match, answerability/abstention, validity and efficiency metrics get the same CI/test machinery but no multiplicity claim; reported as secondary
statistics.sensitivity: descriptive only: metrics restricted to questions where all three systems produced valid generations
statistics.tests: paired cluster sign-randomization, 10,000 draws (heldout v1.1 implementation)
